title: Compatible etale triples and the canonical pushout restriction functor
statement: Let $T,S,T^+,P$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $a:T\to S$, $i:T\to T^+$ morphisms. The category of etale triples has objects $(X\to S,Y\to T^+,\phi)$ with both morphisms etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and $\phi:X\times_ST\simeq Y\times_{T^+}T$ an isomorphism over $T$, using scheme fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]. Morphisms are pairs of morphisms over $S$ and $T^+$ whose base changes commute with $\phi$; identities and composition are componentwise. Given $j:S\to P$ and $b:T^+\to P$ with $ja=bi$, the canonical restriction functor sends an etale scheme $W\to P$ to its base changes to $S$ and $T^+$ and the comparison identifying their further base changes to $T$ with $W\times_PT$. It acts on morphisms by base change. The comparison is the composite of the canonical iterated-pullback isomorphisms.
